WITH plandata AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date,
i.item_name '전체'
AS item_name, sum(pp.prod_plan_qty) total_plan_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN item i ON (pp.item_id = i.item_id)
i.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY pp.prod_plan_date,
i.item_name '전체'
), workdata AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date,
i.item_name '전체'
AS item_name, sum(wo.order_qty) total_order_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN WORK_ORDER wo ON (pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id) JOIN item i ON (pp.item_id = i.item_id)
i.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY pp.prod_plan_date,
i.item_name '전체'
), defectdate AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date,
it.item_name '전체'
AS item_name, sum(dl.defect_qty) total_defect_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN work_order wo ON (pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id) JOIN production p ON (wo.order_id = p.order_id) JOIN inspection i ON (p.prod_id = i.prod_id) JOIN DEFECT_LIST dl ON (i.insp_id = dl.insp_id) JOIN item it ON (pp.item_id = it.item_id)
dl.use_yn = 'Y'
AND it.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY pp.prod_plan_date,
it.item_name '전체'
), defect_reason AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date,
it.item_name '전체'
AS item_name, d.defect_code AS defect_code, d.defect_name AS defect_name, SUM(dl.defect_qty) AS reason_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN work_order wo ON (pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id) JOIN production p ON (wo.order_id = p.order_id) JOIN inspection i ON (p.prod_id = i.prod_id) JOIN DEFECT_LIST dl ON (i.insp_id = dl.insp_id) JOIN defect d ON (dl.defect_id = d.defect_id) JOIN item it ON (pp.item_id = it.item_id)
dl.use_yn = 'Y'
AND it.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY pp.prod_plan_date,
it.item_name '전체'
,d.defect_code, d.defect_name )
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY-IW') 계획일자, p.item_name 품목명, round(sum(total_plan_qty),1) 생산계획량, round(sum(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)),1) 작업량, round(sum(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)),1) 불량수량, ( SELECT LISTAGG(dr.defect_code || '_' || dr.defect_name || ':' || dr.reason_qty, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dr.reason_qty DESC) FROM defect_reason dr WHERE TO_CHAR(dr.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-IW') = TO_CHAR(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-IW') AND dr.item_name = p.item_name ) AS 불량사유상세 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE AND p.item_name = w.item_name LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date AND p.item_name = d.item_name GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-IW'), p.item_name ORDER BY 계획일자, 품목명
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') 계획일자, p.item_name 품목명, total_plan_qty 생산계획량, nvl(w.total_order_qty,0) 작업량, nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0) 불량수량, ( SELECT LISTAGG(dr.defect_code || '_' || dr.defect_name || ':' || dr.reason_qty, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dr.reason_qty DESC) FROM defect_reason dr WHERE TO_CHAR(dr.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND dr.item_name = p.item_name ) AS 불량사유상세 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE AND p.item_name = w.item_name LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date AND p.item_name = d.item_name ORDER BY p.prod_plan_date, p.item_name
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY') 계획일자, p.item_name 품목명, sum(total_plan_qty) 생산계획량, sum(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)) 작업량, sum(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)) 불량수량, ( SELECT LISTAGG(dr.defect_code || '_' || dr.defect_name || ':' || dr.year_reason_qty, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dr.year_reason_qty DESC) FROM ( SELECT plan_year, item_name, defect_code, defect_name, year_reason_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan_year, item_name ORDER BY year_reason_qty DESC) as rnum FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') as plan_year, item_name, defect_code, defect_name, SUM(reason_qty) as year_reason_qty FROM defect_reason GROUP BY TO_CHAR(prod_plan_date, 'YYYY'), item_name, defect_code, defect_name ) ) dr WHERE dr.plan_year = to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') AND dr.item_name = p.item_name AND dr.rnum <= 3 ) AS 불량사유상세 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE AND p.item_name = w.item_name LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date AND p.item_name = d.item_name GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY'), p.item_name ORDER BY 계획일자, 품목명
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY-MM') 계획일자, p.item_name 품목명, round(sum(total_plan_qty),1) 생산계획량, round(sum(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)),1) 작업량, round(sum(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)),1) 불량수량, ( SELECT LISTAGG(dr.defect_code || '_' || dr.defect_name || ':' || dr.reason_qty, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dr.reason_qty DESC) FROM defect_reason dr WHERE TO_CHAR(dr.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM') AND dr.item_name = p.item_name ) AS 불량사유상세 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE AND p.item_name = w.item_name LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date AND p.item_name = d.item_name GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM'), p.item_name ORDER BY 계획일자, 품목명

WITH base_date AS ( SELECT TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 6 + LEVEL - 1 AS base_date FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ), plan_data AS ( SELECT TRUNC(prod_plan_date) AS base_date, SUM(NVL(prod_plan_qty, 0)) AS plan_qty FROM production_plan WHERE prod_plan_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 6 AND prod_plan_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(prod_plan_date) ), prod_data AS ( SELECT TRUNC(prod_date) AS base_date, SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)) AS prod_qty FROM production WHERE prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 6 AND prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(prod_date) ) SELECT TO_CHAR(b.base_date, 'MM/DD') AS LABEL, NVL(p.plan_qty, 0) AS PLANQTY, NVL(pr.prod_qty, 0) AS PRODQTY FROM base_date b LEFT JOIN plan_data p ON p.base_date = b.base_date LEFT JOIN prod_data pr ON pr.base_date = b.base_date ORDER BY b.base_date

WITH week_data AS ( SELECT NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(prod_plan_qty, 0)) FROM production_plan WHERE prod_plan_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') AND prod_plan_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') + 7 ), 0) AS curr_plan_qty,
NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)) FROM production WHERE prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') AND prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') + 7 ), 0) AS curr_prod_qty,
NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)) FROM production WHERE prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') - 7 AND prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') ), 0) AS prev_prod_qty FROM dual ) SELECT curr_plan_qty AS CURRPLANQTY, curr_prod_qty AS CURRPRODQTY, prev_prod_qty AS PREVPRODQTY,
CASE WHEN curr_plan_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(curr_prod_qty / curr_plan_qty * 100, 1) END AS PLANRATE,
CASE WHEN prev_prod_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((curr_prod_qty - prev_prod_qty) / prev_prod_qty * 100, 1) END AS WEEKCOMPARERATE,
CASE WHEN curr_prod_qty - prev_prod_qty >= 0 THEN 'up' ELSE 'down' END AS WEEKCOMPARETYPE FROM week_data

WITH base_date AS ( SELECT TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 6 + LEVEL - 1 AS base_date FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ), prod_data AS ( SELECT TRUNC(prod_date) AS base_date, SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)) AS prod_qty FROM production WHERE prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 6 AND prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(prod_date) ), defect_data AS ( SELECT TRUNC(p.prod_date) AS base_date, SUM(NVL(dl.defect_qty, 0)) AS defect_qty FROM production p JOIN inspection i ON p.prod_id = i.prod_id JOIN defect_list dl ON i.insp_id = dl.insp_id WHERE p.prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 6 AND p.prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(p.prod_date) ) SELECT TO_CHAR(b.base_date, 'MM/DD') AS LABEL, NVL(p.prod_qty, 0) AS PRODQTY, NVL(d.defect_qty, 0) AS DEFECTQTY, CASE WHEN NVL(p.prod_qty, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(NVL(d.defect_qty, 0) / p.prod_qty * 100, 1) END AS DEFECTRATE FROM base_date b LEFT JOIN prod_data p ON p.base_date = b.base_date LEFT JOIN defect_data d ON d.base_date = b.base_date ORDER BY b.base_date

WITH week_data AS ( SELECT NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(p.prod_qty, 0)) FROM production p WHERE p.prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') AND p.prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') + 7 ), 0) AS curr_prod_qty,
NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(dl.defect_qty, 0)) FROM production p JOIN inspection i ON p.prod_id = i.prod_id JOIN defect_list dl ON i.insp_id = dl.insp_id WHERE p.prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') AND p.prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') + 7 ), 0) AS curr_defect_qty,
NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(p.prod_qty, 0)) FROM production p WHERE p.prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') - 7 AND p.prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') ), 0) AS prev_prod_qty,
NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(dl.defect_qty, 0)) FROM production p JOIN inspection i ON p.prod_id = i.prod_id JOIN defect_list dl ON i.insp_id = dl.insp_id WHERE p.prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') - 7 AND p.prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') ), 0) AS prev_defect_qty FROM dual ), rate_data AS ( SELECT curr_prod_qty, curr_defect_qty, prev_prod_qty, prev_defect_qty,
CASE WHEN curr_prod_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(curr_defect_qty / curr_prod_qty * 100, 1) END AS curr_defect_rate,
CASE WHEN prev_prod_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(prev_defect_qty / prev_prod_qty * 100, 1) END AS prev_defect_rate FROM week_data ) SELECT curr_prod_qty AS CURRPRODQTY, curr_defect_qty AS CURRDEFECTQTY, prev_prod_qty AS PREVPRODQTY, prev_defect_qty AS PREVDEFECTQTY, curr_defect_rate AS CURRDEFECTRATE, prev_defect_rate AS PREVDEFECTRATE,
CASE WHEN prev_defect_rate = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((curr_defect_rate - prev_defect_rate) / prev_defect_rate * 100, 1) END AS WEEKCOMPARERATE,
CASE WHEN curr_defect_rate - prev_defect_rate > 0 THEN 'bad' WHEN curr_defect_rate - prev_defect_rate < 0 THEN 'good' ELSE 'same' END AS WEEKCOMPARETYPE FROM rate_data

WITH base_date AS ( SELECT TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 6 + LEVEL - 1 AS base_date FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ), actual_data AS ( SELECT TRUNC(cost_date) AS base_date, ROUND(AVG(NVL(unit_cost, 0)), 0) AS actual_unit_cost FROM actual_cost_daily WHERE cost_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 6 AND cost_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(cost_date) ), standard_data AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(NVL(unit_cost, 0)), 0) AS target_unit_cost FROM standard_cost WHERE NVL(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ) SELECT TO_CHAR(b.base_date, 'MM/DD') AS LABEL, a.actual_unit_cost AS ACTUALCOST, s.target_unit_cost AS TARGETCOST FROM base_date b CROSS JOIN standard_data s LEFT JOIN actual_data a ON a.base_date = b.base_date ORDER BY b.base_date

WITH base_data AS ( SELECT NVL(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(NVL(unit_cost, 0)), 0) FROM actual_cost_daily WHERE cost_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') AND cost_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') + 7 ), 0) AS curr_actual_cost,
NVL(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(NVL(unit_cost, 0)), 0) FROM actual_cost_daily WHERE cost_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') - 7 AND cost_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, 'IW') ), 0) AS prev_actual_cost,
NVL(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(NVL(unit_cost, 0)), 0) FROM standard_cost WHERE NVL(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ), 0) AS target_cost FROM dual ) SELECT curr_actual_cost AS CURRACTUALCOST, prev_actual_cost AS PREVACTUALCOST, target_cost AS TARGETCOST,
CASE WHEN target_cost = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((curr_actual_cost - target_cost) / target_cost * 100, 1) END AS TARGETCOMPARERATE,
CASE WHEN prev_actual_cost = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((curr_actual_cost - prev_actual_cost) / prev_actual_cost * 100, 1) END AS WEEKCOMPARERATE,
CASE WHEN curr_actual_cost - target_cost > 0 THEN 'bad' WHEN curr_actual_cost - target_cost < 0 THEN 'good' ELSE 'same' END AS TARGETCOMPARETYPE,
CASE WHEN curr_actual_cost - prev_actual_cost > 0 THEN 'bad' WHEN curr_actual_cost - prev_actual_cost < 0 THEN 'good' ELSE 'same' END AS WEEKCOMPARETYPE FROM base_data

WITH status_data AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN equip_status = '가동' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS running_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN equip_status NOT IN ('가동', '비가동', '정지') OR equip_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS check_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN equip_status IN ('비가동', '정지') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS stop_count FROM equipment WHERE NVL(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ), rate_data AS ( SELECT total_count, running_count, check_count, stop_count, check_count + stop_count AS non_running_count,
CASE WHEN total_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(running_count / total_count * 100, 1) END AS run_rate,
CASE WHEN total_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((check_count + stop_count) / total_count * 100, 1) END AS non_run_rate,
CASE WHEN total_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(check_count / total_count * 100, 1) END AS check_rate,
CASE WHEN total_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(stop_count / total_count * 100, 1) END AS stop_rate FROM status_data ), final_data AS ( SELECT total_count, running_count, check_count, stop_count, non_running_count, run_rate, non_run_rate, check_rate, stop_rate, 80 AS target_rate, ROUND(run_rate - 80, 1) AS target_gap FROM rate_data ) SELECT total_count AS TOTALCOUNT, running_count AS RUNNINGCOUNT, check_count AS CHECKCOUNT, stop_count AS STOPCOUNT, non_running_count AS NONRUNNINGCOUNT,
run_rate AS RUNRATE, non_run_rate AS NONRUNRATE, check_rate AS CHECKRATE, stop_rate AS STOPRATE,
target_rate AS TARGETRATE, target_gap AS TARGETGAP,
CASE WHEN target_gap > 0 THEN 'good' WHEN target_gap < 0 THEN 'bad' ELSE 'same' END AS TARGETTYPE FROM final_data

WITH prod_sum AS ( SELECT order_id, SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)) AS total_prod_qty FROM production GROUP BY order_id ), delay_lot AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wo.product_lot) AS delay_lot_count FROM work_order wo JOIN production_plan pp ON pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)) AS total_prod_qty, MAX( CASE WHEN prod_status IN ('완료', '취소') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS close_yn FROM production GROUP BY order_id ) ps ON ps.order_id = wo.order_id WHERE wo.order_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 AND wo.product_lot IS NOT NULL AND NVL(ps.close_yn, 0) = 0 AND NVL(ps.total_prod_qty, 0) < NVL(wo.order_qty, 0) ), inspection_wait_lot AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wo.product_lot) AS inspection_wait_lot_count FROM inspection i JOIN production p ON p.prod_id = i.prod_id JOIN work_order wo ON wo.order_id = p.order_id WHERE NVL(i.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND wo.product_lot IS NOT NULL AND ( NVL(i.insp_status, '-') IN ('대기', '검사 예정') OR NVL(i.result, '-') = '대기' OR NVL(p.inspection_status, '-') IN ('대기', '검사 예정') ) ), finished_wait_lot AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wo.product_lot) AS finished_wait_lot_count FROM product_inout pi JOIN work_order wo ON wo.order_id = pi.order_id JOIN inspection i ON i.insp_id = pi.insp_id WHERE pi.inout_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND pi.inout_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 AND NVL(pi.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND pi.inout_type = 'MI' AND wo.product_lot IS NOT NULL AND NVL(i.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND i.insp_status IN ('완료', '검사 완료') AND i.result IN ('합격', '조건부합격') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_inout po WHERE po.order_id = pi.order_id AND NVL(po.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND po.inout_type IN ('MO', 'OUT', 'SO', '출고', '출하') ) ) SELECT d.delay_lot_count AS DELAYLOTCOUNT, i.inspection_wait_lot_count AS INSPECTIONWAITLOTCOUNT, f.finished_wait_lot_count AS FINISHEDSHIPWAITLOTCOUNT FROM delay_lot d CROSS JOIN inspection_wait_lot i CROSS JOIN finished_wait_lot f

SELECT defect_issue_count + trouble_issue_count + delay_issue_count AS ISSUECOUNT,
CASE WHEN defect_issue_count = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DEFECTISSUEYN, defect_rate AS DEFECTRATE, 1.5 AS DEFECTSTANDARDRATE, NVL(defect_issue_time, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'HH24:MI')) AS DEFECTISSUETIME,
CASE WHEN trouble_issue_count = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS TROUBLEISSUEYN, trouble_count AS TROUBLECOUNT, NVL(trouble_issue_time, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'HH24:MI')) AS TROUBLEISSUETIME, NVL(trouble_message, '미조치 설비 고장 없음') AS TROUBLEMESSAGE,
CASE WHEN delay_issue_count = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DELAYISSUEYN, delay_order_count AS DELAYORDERCOUNT, NVL(delay_issue_time, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'MM/DD')) AS DELAYISSUETIME FROM ( SELECT defect_rate, defect_issue_time, trouble_count, trouble_issue_time, trouble_message, delay_order_count, delay_issue_time,
CASE WHEN defect_rate > 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS defect_issue_count,
CASE WHEN trouble_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS trouble_issue_count,
CASE WHEN delay_order_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS delay_issue_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN today_prod_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(today_defect_qty / today_prod_qty * 100, 1) END AS defect_rate, defect_issue_time, trouble_count, trouble_issue_time, trouble_message, delay_order_count, delay_issue_time FROM ( SELECT NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)) FROM production WHERE prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 ), 0) AS today_prod_qty,
NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(dl.defect_qty, 0)) FROM defect_list dl JOIN inspection i ON i.insp_id = dl.insp_id JOIN production p ON p.prod_id = i.prod_id WHERE p.prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND p.prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 AND NVL(dl.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(i.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ), 0) AS today_defect_qty,
( SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(dl.defect_date), 'HH24:MI') FROM defect_list dl JOIN inspection i ON i.insp_id = dl.insp_id JOIN production p ON p.prod_id = i.prod_id WHERE p.prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND p.prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 AND NVL(dl.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(i.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ) AS defect_issue_time,
NVL(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_trouble et WHERE et.resolve_date IS NULL AND et.trouble_date IS NOT NULL AND et.trouble_content IS NOT NULL ), 0) AS trouble_count,
( SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(et.trouble_date), 'HH24:MI') FROM equipment_trouble et WHERE et.resolve_date IS NULL AND et.trouble_date IS NOT NULL AND et.trouble_content IS NOT NULL ) AS trouble_issue_time,
( SELECT MAX(e.equip_name || ' ' || et.trouble_content) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY et.trouble_date) FROM equipment_trouble et JOIN equipment e ON e.equip_id = et.equip_id WHERE et.resolve_date IS NULL AND et.trouble_date IS NOT NULL AND et.trouble_content IS NOT NULL ) AS trouble_message,
NVL(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wo.order_id) FROM work_order wo JOIN production_plan pp ON pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)) AS total_prod_qty, MAX( CASE WHEN prod_status IN ('완료', '취소') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS close_yn FROM production GROUP BY order_id ) ps ON ps.order_id = wo.order_id WHERE pp.due_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND NVL(ps.total_prod_qty, 0) < NVL(wo.order_qty, 0) AND NVL(ps.close_yn, 0) = 0 AND wo.product_lot IS NOT NULL ), 0) AS delay_order_count,
( SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(pp.due_date), 'MM/DD') FROM work_order wo JOIN production_plan pp ON pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)) AS total_prod_qty, MAX( CASE WHEN prod_status IN ('완료', '취소') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS close_yn FROM production GROUP BY order_id ) ps ON ps.order_id = wo.order_id WHERE pp.due_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND NVL(ps.total_prod_qty, 0) < NVL(wo.order_qty, 0) AND NVL(ps.close_yn, 0) = 0 AND wo.product_lot IS NOT NULL ) AS delay_issue_time FROM dual ) ) )

WITH curr_plan AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(prod_plan_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty FROM production_plan WHERE prod_plan_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND prod_plan_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 ), prev_plan AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(prod_plan_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty FROM production_plan WHERE prod_plan_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AND prod_plan_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) ), curr_prod AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty FROM production WHERE prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 ), prev_prod AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(prod_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty FROM production WHERE prod_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AND prod_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) ), curr_defect AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(dl.defect_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty FROM inspection i JOIN defect_list dl ON dl.insp_id = i.insp_id WHERE i.insp_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND i.insp_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 AND NVL(i.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(dl.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ), prev_defect AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(dl.defect_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty FROM inspection i JOIN defect_list dl ON dl.insp_id = i.insp_id WHERE i.insp_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AND i.insp_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND NVL(i.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(dl.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ), curr_insp AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(inspection_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty FROM inspection WHERE insp_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AND insp_date < TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 AND NVL(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ), prev_insp AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(inspection_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty FROM inspection WHERE insp_date >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) -
